text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tryouts—a stage where runners aspiring to
make their debut can show
off their skills
to trainers.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She lives up to the hype! Her speed is
incredible! She's crossing the
finish line
with two whole lengths ahead of the pack!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! If you join me, I'll make sure
you win a graded race! Even
G1 races will
be in your reach!

text_block_list.name: First Place Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The students pour their hearts and souls
into running, and trainers do
everything in
their power to make their racers' dreams
come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My desire to support them is strong, but
when it comes to actual
scouting, I find
myself freezing up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, the morning tryouts have
ended. I leave the course
without the
courage to even speak to a single person.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I take it you haven't found your perfect
trainee yet?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, excuse me for coming up to you so
suddenly. My name is Super
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're new to Tracen Academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I just had a feeling. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I noticed you were struggling to talk to the
runners and how you were
intimidated by
the other trainers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure there's a runner out there
waiting for you, so please don't
give up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe that I'm the one being
encouraged by a student. It's
usually the
other way around...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It seems like there's a reason why it's hard
for you to speak up.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to share your thoughts
with me? Sometimes it helps to
get things
off your chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I express my worries about how the more
experienced trainers might
be better
suited for such passionate athletes.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so that's how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's nervous and wants to be extra
cautious in the beginning.
But that's a
good thing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It shows that you're a kind and considerate
person. You really take
your job
seriously... At least, that's how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I'll be running in a race later
this afternoon. If you're
interested, would
you like to come and see?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you. You won't regret it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel a sense of ease wash over me as I
listen to her words and see
her smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The afternoon race begins, and Super
Creek bursts from the starting
gate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The leading pack has rounded the first
corner! Super Creek is already
breaking
away from the group!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without faltering even once, she continues
to dominate until the very
end.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek charges down the track and
finishes in first place!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Creek! Let's work together to win G1
races!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely help you reach your full
potential!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Thank you for all of your offers,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, you've lived up to all of my
expectations. Come with
me, and I'll
prioritize your training.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Y-you! I knew it, you just had to show up and snatch her away...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unparalleled among his peers, one of the
top veteran trainers in all of
Tracen
Academy has come to scout Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's an honor to have a famous
trainer such as yourself show
interest in
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right... A talented racer like Super
Creek deserves nothing less
than a
top-class trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After thinking about what's best for her, I
begin to take my leave.
However, just as I
turn around...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I received many good offers today, but I
believe you're the best fit
for me.

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Are you out of your mind?! This
rookie has no track record
at all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A rookie trainer is still a trainer. Isn't that
right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she smiles at me, the same feeling of
ease envelopes me again.
The tension in
my body melts away.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Will you partner up with me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the honor is all mine. I look forward
to working with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I finally take my first step toward
my future as a trainer.
